name: SACAM v0.1 benchmark pre-registration
approval: Milestone 1 approved as designed by the requester; scripted identical write-directive stream approved.

benchmark.immutability: Tasks frozen after generation. Any change requires a new minor version (v0.2), never a silent edit.

memory_interface.adversarial_metadata: is forecast as item-level 'adversarial' flag; NEVER rendered into prompts (only source/timestamp/confidence/authority are).
memory_interface.retrieval: deterministic local term-overlap (frozen STOPWORDS); exactly one retrieval per task, at the query turn.

evaluation.success_predicate: contains_all on success_criterion.values, with forbid-only support

evidence_against_rules.E1_direction: median(TSR(sacam) - TSR(naive)) <= 0 or bootstrap upper bound <= 0
evidence_against_rules.E3_retention_tradeoff: MCS advantage while TSR(sacam, retention) - TSR(naive, retention) < -0.05
evidence_against_rules.E5_misattribution: SACAM gain dominated by fewer REASONING_FAILURE labels rather than stale/forgetting/adversarial labels

constraints: No fabrication of results; no tuning on the frozen task set.
Raw results preserved append-only; never overwritten.
Any label beyond the frozen taxonomy, or any null-answer, is classified OTHER (never silently dropped).
SACAM v0 is a placeholder plugin only; its results are not evidence about the full sleep-consolidation architecture.
Smoke runs use a deterministic mock reader and yield NO research claims.
